title: CS daily scratchpad - account reminders + QBR prep
content:
TODAY (2026-06-10) - quick hits / running list

Top priorities:
- FINCO (Enterprise) QBR @ 3:00pm PT — finalize slides + runbook. Owner: Jordan to update performance slides (latency/cost) by 12pm. I will add usage highlights + recent incidents.
- RENEWAL: DataWave (renewal 2026-07-05) — need exec intro + draft renewal email. Target to lock by 6/24. Contact: Maria (procurement).
- SUPPORT: Ticket #JIRA-CS-812 - model mismatch on embeddings for search index (Customer: RetailCo). Escalated to infra on 6/9, awaiting patch ETA. Check in w/ SRE (Samira).

QBR prep checklist (FINCO):
- Slides: exec summary, adoption metrics (tokens/day), top 3 use cases, performance trends (p95 latency) — source: analytics dashboard (console -> FINCO-route).
- Incidents / reliability review: April outage notes + mitigation (caching + retry policy). Short bullet on root cause + next steps.
- Cost optimization opportunities: suggest batching + quantization pilot for non-critical endpoints (estimate $Xk/month) — need backend cost numbers from Ryan.
- Asks: confirm decision maker list (CTO, Head of AI, Prod Ops) + proposed next steps (pilot timeline).
- Appendix: links to model versions, metrics queries, previous QBR (confluence).

Renewals / outreach:
- DataWave: draft email snippet below. Follow up in 3 days if no reply. High priority—likely sensitive to price.
- GreenHealth: mid-market, upsell to dedicated planned for Q3. Confirm tech fit call next week (6/16).

Support follow-ups / open items:
- RetailCo (JIRA-CS-812): 1) confirm whether quantized model introduced drift 2) ask devs to run regression on sample set. Note: customer provided sample input set v2 on 6/8.
- EduLabs: meet Wed to show new streaming responses; prepare demo script.

Sticky questions / blockers:
- Do we have finalized estimates for batching savings per model family? (I asked infra last week; no firm numbers.) Needed for FINCO cost section.
- Who owns the DataWave commercial negotiation doc? (Sales/AM?) Might need intro to legal for T&Cs.

Quick templates:
- Renewal outreach (DataWave):
  Subject: Redwood renewal & pilot options — DataWave (renewal 7/5)
  Hi Maria,
  Quick note to confirm renewal options and a recommended pilot to reduce inference costs by ~20%. Can we schedule a 30-min call wk of 6/22 to review details?
  Thanks, Ben

- QBR runbook (30m): 0-5m intro, 5-15m adoption + metrics, 15-20m reliability + incidents, 20-25m cost ops, 25-30m next steps & decisions.

Notes to self:
- Pull p95/p99 latency query for FINCO from console (route: /finco-prod).
- Ask Ryan for Dedicated pricing comps (DataWave negotiation).
- Confirm Jordan updated slide deck by noon. If not, I will patch the exec summary.

Links / refs:
- FINCO QBR draft (confluence): CONFLUENCE-CS/FINCO-QBR-2026-05
- RetailCo ticket: JIRA-CS-812

End-of-day TODO (check off):
- [ ] FINCO slides final
- [ ] Send DataWave draft email
- [ ] Check-in with Samira on RetailCo patch ETA
- [ ] Upload QBR deck to shared drive + invite FINCO attendees

Random / scratch notes (brain dump):
- Consider adding small section on "fallback policy" examples (how we gracefully degrade to smaller model variant). FINCO asked about SLAs.
- Could propose 1-month quantization pilot for lower-cost endpoints — concrete numbers help close renewal.
